title: Head of Finance & Operations
summary: Leading financial strategy, statutory URA compliance, treasury management, and regional operational reporting for an expanding freight group.
description: Our client, a prominent East African transport and freight forwarding company, is seeking an experienced Head of Finance & Operations to oversee core financial controls, audit preparedness, and cross-border customs reconciliation.
requirements:
• Minimum 7+ years of progressive financial management and operational accounting experience
• Certified Public Accountant (CPA-U or ACCA) in good standing
• Demonstrable experience managing URA corporate tax, PAYE audits, and customs clearing reconciliation
• Advanced proficiency in ERP systems (SAP, Navision, or NetSuite)
• Prior experience leading cross-functional teams across East Africa

screeningQuestions.question: How many years of commercial financial controller or senior accounting experience do you have?
Are you a fully certified member of CPA Uganda (ICPAU) or ACCA in good standing?
Which enterprise ERP system are you most proficient in?
Are you currently based in Kampala or able to commute to the Industrial Area office daily?

description: Our client is an international NGO operating health and education programs across East Africa. This role partners directly with Country Leadership to implement progressive HR policies aligned with Uganda's Employment Act.
